'''Chapter 115''' is titled "Little Garden of Adventure".

==Cover Page==
[[Diary of Koby-Meppo]], Vol. 27: "Special Training During Valuable Sleeping Time!!".

By night, [[Koby]] and [[Helmeppo]] begin their recruit training proper—training they never could have dreamed of back in the [[East Blue]].

==Short Summary==
The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] reach the second island on the [[Grand Line]], [[Little Garden]]—the home of pre-historic animals.

==Long Summary==
[[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] begins to appreciate life on board the [[Going Merry]] and the carefree lifestyle of her new friends. She has reservations as she constantly warns them to not underestimate the dangers that await them on the Grand Line.

After a calm journey, they finally arrive at Little Garden, about which [[Nico Robin|Miss All Sunday]] had warned them. It appears to be a weird tropical forest and is inhabited by even stranger animals. [[Nami]] is not eager to leave the boat as their [[Log Pose]] resets but the rest of the crew has an opposing opinion. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] craves adventure and decides to set out to explore. Much to Nami's surprise, Vivi decides to accompany Luffy in order to be distracted from her worries. She drags along a not-so-willing [[Karoo]].

After they depart, [[Sanji]] asks [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] to go on a hunt in order to retrieve more food as they are running low. Zoro, who is not so pleased to work on Sanji's orders, replies with a nasty comment that he would get something bigger than Sanji anyways. Sanji refuses to lose face in front of Nami and challenges Zoro to a hunt contest—to see who can bring back the largest weight in food for the crew.

Luffy and Vivi discover weird animals and they realize Little Garden is, in fact, a prehistoric island which has stayed evolutionary-wise at the dinosaur era.

Meanwhile back at the boat, Nami and [[Usopp]] are alone and not confident aboard the Going Merry. Nami finds a book which explains the island's name. Suddenly a [[Brogy|giant shadow]] approaches them.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*It is mentioned that [[Usopp]] will build a fishing pole.
*This is the first time [[Little Garden]] appears.
*[[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Sanji]] start a competition to see who can hunt the larger animal, which also sparks their long-lasting rivalry.
*The crew see [[Animal Species/Arabasta Saga#Dinosaurs and other Prehistoric Animals|prehistoric animals]] for the first time: an ''{{W|Archaeopteryx}}'', an ''{{W|Ammonite}}'', and a ''{{W|Brontosaurus}}''.
*The crew encounters a [[Giants|giant]] (shadowed) for the first time.
*This is the first chapter of the [[Little Garden Arc]].

==Trivia==
* Though the opening scene is implied to directly continue from [[Chapter 114|the previous chapter]], both Nami and Vivi are shown in different outfits.
*This is the first chapter in the series where an arc begins with a chapter with the word "Adventure" in the title, which will become standard for many of the Grand Line arcs.
